title: Apophis
subtitle: Coming close in 2029
yt_title: This Asteroid Passes Closer Than Satellites in 2029 ☄️ | Ep. 35 #shorts
description:
Episode 35 of a daily journey through the universe. ☄️
We meet Apophis: a 340-meter asteroid that will pass just 32,000 km from Earth on April 13, 2029, visible without a telescope, with zero chance of impact for at least 100 years.

➡️ Tomorrow, Episode 36: Next stop, Halley's Comet. Once in a lifetime.

#space #apophis #astronomy #shorts #science

segments.text: Apophis is an asteroid about three hundred forty meters wide.
segments.headline: 340 meters wide

segments.text: On April thirteenth, twenty twenty-nine, it will pass about thirty-two thousand kilometers from Earth. Closer than some of our satellites.
It will be so close that people in parts of Europe, Africa and Asia could see it without a telescope.
segments.headline: Visible with your eyes

segments.text: And the chance it hits us? Zero, for at least the next hundred years.
NASA's OSIRIS-APEX spacecraft will meet it after the flyby, to see how Earth's gravity changed it.
segments.headline: A spacecraft will follow it
